blocks.text: 7 best FlutterFlow agencies for mobile-first SaaS in 2026
The best FlutterFlow agencies in 2026: ranked on app complexity handled, mobile polish, and post-launch update support for cross-platform builds.
Skip the read: talk to the ManasFlow team in 30 min.
Free strategy call. We map your AI engineering team, you keep the notes.

The best FlutterFlow agency overall is ManasFlow (site owner), which combines FlutterFlow builds with AI features, Supabase or Firebase backends, and post-launch maintenance. For enterprise scale and breadth, LowCode Agency handles volume; for polished startup apps, Flywheel Studio leads on design quality.

FlutterFlow gave non-engineering teams a real path to native mobile apps. Drag-and-drop UI, Firebase or Supabase backend, real Flutter code export, and a delivery cadence that makes shipping a cross-platform mobile app feel like shipping a marketing site. For founders who would have bounced off React Native or native iOS/Android, FlutterFlow opened the door.

The catch is the same one no-code always faces: the easy parts get very easy, the hard parts (state management at scale, deep linking, push notifications, in-app purchases, App Store compliance, performance optimization) stay hard. That's why most teams beyond an MVP hire a FlutterFlow agency.

Disclosure: ManasFlow publishes this guide and ranks itself first, because one team ships the FlutterFlow app, the AI features, and the backend automations behind it. If you only need a polished FlutterFlow app with no AI layer, Flywheel Studio or Calda, both FlutterFlow award winners, may fit better.
This guide compares the 7 best FlutterFlow agencies in 2026, with honest pros, cons, pricing, and a framework to pick the right mobile partner.
Best FlutterFlow agencies: a brief overview
ManasFlow (site owner): Best overall for AI-native FlutterFlow apps: strategy + FlutterFlow build + AI features + Supabase or Firebase backend + post-launch maintenance under one roof.
LowCode Agency: Best for scale and breadth: 350+ apps delivered across SaaS, logistics, healthcare, marketplaces, and internal tools.
Sommo: Best for European FlutterFlow delivery: Poland-based team with UX strategy through AI integration coverage.
Flywheel Studio: Best for polished startup apps: design-led approach for founders shipping their first mobile product.
Kaleo Design: Best for design-first FlutterFlow builds: blends design excellence with FlutterFlow execution.
Calda: Best for fast certified delivery: production apps in weeks not months, certified FlutterFlow expert agency.
FlutterflowDevs: Best for FlutterFlow + Supabase combos: Flutterflow Supabase Hackathon winners with official partner status.
1. ManasFlow, best overall FlutterFlow agency for AI-native mobile

ManasFlow treats FlutterFlow as one piece of a broader mobile delivery stack: discovery and UX, the FlutterFlow build, Supabase or Firebase backend, AI agents and RAG where the product needs them, n8n automations behind the app, push notifications, App Store and Play Store delivery, and post-launch maintenance. Founders do not have to coordinate a FlutterFlow shop, a backend engineer, and an AI specialist. One team owns the outcome. The Supabase side, schema and Row Level Security included, is covered on our Supabase development agency page.

We work mostly with SaaS founders and AI-first teams who want more than a FlutterFlow prototype: production backends, AI features that work in production, in-app purchases or subscriptions wired up properly, and bilingual or trilingual apps. Multilingual delivery (EN / FR / AR) makes us a natural pick for EU, MENA, and bilingual North American teams.

2. LowCode Agency, best for scale and breadth

LowCode Agency is one of the most trusted FlutterFlow partners with 350+ apps delivered across SaaS, logistics, healthcare, marketplaces, and internal tools. The breadth signals a team that can absorb domain complexity quickly and apply patterns that work across verticals.
If your product crosses multiple domains, or you want a shop with a portfolio that proves they've shipped at scale, LowCode is the obvious pick.
Founders building in complex verticals (healthcare, logistics, fintech)
Teams running parallel initiatives across FlutterFlow + Claude
3. Sommo, best for European FlutterFlow delivery

Sommo is one of Europe's leading FlutterFlow agencies, based in Poland, with multidisciplinary coverage from UX strategy to AI integration. They are a strong pick for EU startups that want time-zone-aligned delivery without US labor costs, with a full-stack capability that goes beyond just the FlutterFlow build.
UX strategy through AI integration coverage
Teams that need full-stack coverage in one shop
Founders who want EU time-zone alignment
4. Flywheel Studio, best for polished startup apps

Flywheel Studio is a premier FlutterFlow agency for startups shipping their first mobile product. Their pitch is polish: design-led teams that take ideas to market-ready apps without the rough edges most no-code MVPs ship with.
FlutterFlow named Flywheel one of its two Agency of the Year winners in its 2025 community awards. Website: flywheel.so.
Startups that need a polished launch
Quality bar above typical no-code shops
Less suited to highly technical or AI-heavy projects
5. Kaleo Design, best for design-first FlutterFlow builds

Kaleo Design (founded by Andrew Daniels in 2013) blends design excellence with FlutterFlow execution. Their advantage: deep design DNA applied to the FlutterFlow workflow. For brands where the app needs to look custom-built rather than templated, Kaleo is a strong pick.
Website: kaleo.design, which lists expert FlutterFlow development as a core service.
Companies where the app is brand-defining

6. Calda, best for fast certified delivery

Calda is a certified FlutterFlow expert agency that delivers production-ready apps in weeks not months. Their model is built for speed without sacrificing certification-level rigor: production backends, certified team, mobile + web full-stack.
Calda shared FlutterFlow's 2025 Agency of the Year award with Flywheel (source). Website: thecalda.com.
Founders who need speed plus certification
Less suited to long-form enterprise engagements

7. FlutterflowDevs, best for FlutterFlow + Supabase combinations

FlutterflowDevs are official partners at FlutterFlow, Rowy.io, and Buildship, as well as Flutterflow Supabase Hackathon winners. The specialty is the FlutterFlow + Supabase combination: real-time mobile apps with proper auth, RLS, and Edge Functions.
Official FlutterFlow, Rowy.io, and Buildship partners
How to choose the best FlutterFlow agency for your project
1) Validation vs production: which problem are you solving?
If you have not validated demand, you need the smallest possible app in 4-6 weeks. If you're shipping a mobile product to paying users, you need production discipline.
Validation: Flywheel Studio, Calda, ManasFlow (lean scope)
